bullets: Compare responses at the same tested concentration.
Use concentration responses to resolve close screening ranks.

slides.title: Ranking: measured versus bounded
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: Lower inhibition at 10 µM is the favourable direction.
Finite IC50s support ordering within the tested range.
Censored IC50s define a bound, not an exact order above the top concentration.
bullets_right: TP04-02700 has censored cell responses in the results table.
Keep its finite-cell count attached to the summary.
Read the flagged row in context before a close compound selection.
slides.notes: A bounded response is not absence of channel interaction. Screening decisions do not identify a molecular explanation for the tail effect.
